privacy.summary: Lets visitors text your show. Every phone number and message is kept on this player until you delete it, message text goes to an online swearing checker, and setup has you open FPP to the internet.

sends.what: your Twilio login, visitors' phone numbers and the text replies sent to them
sends.why: to send text replies and, in polling mode, to collect and then delete every text in your account

sends.what: the full text of every visitor's message, plus your checker login
sends.why: to check messages for swearing; used unless you pick the other checker

sends.what: the full text of every visitor's message, plus your checker password
sends.why: to check messages for swearing, if you pick this checker instead

sends.what: visitors' message text and play/stop commands
sends.why: to show messages on a sign or control a second player, only if you set one up

collects.what: every visitor's phone number, what they texted and when, plus numbers you have blocked
every visitor's phone number and message, plus your swearing-checker login

systemChanges.what: setup tells you to open a door from the internet to this player, so anyone online can reach every FPP page

privacy.other: In polling mode it keeps contacting Twilio even with the plugin switched off. Visitors are given no notice. The message database, log, saved passwords and any door you opened stay after uninstall.
